Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated refraction with reflection and selected mirrors, overemphasizing minor refraction effects of mirror substrates instead of the primary behavior (mirrors reflect). It ignored that eyeglasses (lenses) are the best example of refraction and prematurely declared TASK_COMPLETE without consulting other specialists or validating the concept.
